new thinking clip and its sampled idle entry/exit
notCovered: old wave repair or old wave PASS inheritance
mobile runtime screenshots not yet independently viewed in this report

evidence.source: Actual same-component local browser runtime screenshots supplied by primary agent, independently cropped and visually reviewed.
evidence.displaySize: 180px desktop launcher; crop preserves screenshot pixel scale and fixed position.
evidence.runtimeStateCrossCheck: Read browser/runtime-samples.json: bow enters at screenshot 1 and returns idle at 65; thinking enters at 7 and returns idle at 72. This locates the visual boundary independently of endpoint hashes.
evidence.samplingLimit: Screenshots sample runtime at approximately 50-60ms per primary-agent capture; this report does not claim every rendered intermediate frame was independently captured. Earlier source-frame review covers all action PNGs.

bow.result: No visually blocking defect found in captured desktop runtime sequence.
bow.entry: Action begins without an obvious character replacement, duplicated face or body displacement.
bow.body: Hand-to-chest and bow are readable; local repaired return hand does not present an obvious new seam or isolated size jump at this display size.
bow.exit: Reviewed settling, bridge and actual return around screenshots 55-70, including idle change at 65. No conspicuous single-frame colour flash, doubled clothes or abrupt contour replacement observed. Last twenty captures remain visually stable idle.

thinking.result: No visually blocking defect found in captured desktop runtime sequence.
thinking.entry: Entry from moving idle to thinking is visually coherent in sampled screenshots.
thinking.body: Thinking gesture and head tilt remain recognisable. Low-detail moving fingers do not read as a major extra/missing-limb event at the tested 180px display size.
thinking.exit: Reviewed hand lowering and bridge through screenshots 50-79, including actual idle return at 72. No conspicuous colour flash or duplicate eye/clothing contour observed. Last twenty screenshots are idle, including its normal blink rather than an action-transition defect.

findings.edgeQuality: Minor antialiasing/fine hair and finger softness remains, particularly under enlarged source inspection. In these actual-size dark-background runtime captures it does not form a large white fringe or blocking temporal artifact.
findings.sharpness: Subtle source sharpness differences still exist; the tested transition reduces abruptness. This approval is not a claim of pixel-identical style across every original source frame.
findings.backgroundControl: Bow screenshot 000 shows pale background and subsequent screenshots dark. This coincides with test background state and is not treated as a character-animation colour flash.

recommendation: New bow and thinking clips may pass the desktop runtime visual gate for this release, provided the separate functional, asset-integrity and deployment checks pass. Do not mark the old wave complaints solved or inherit any historic wave quality PASS into this decision.
oldWaveStatus: User-reported old wave issues remain outside this repair scope and were not approved by this review.
